content:
Continuing from the reflection:
\[
2+(n-9)d=30 \implies (n-9)d=28.
\]
Using \(S_n=336\):
\[
S_n=\frac{n}{2}\bigl(2a+(n-1)d\bigr).
\]
Since \(a=2-4d\),
\[
2a+(n-1)d=4-8d+(n-1)d=4+(n-9)d.
\]
Thus
\[
336=\frac{n}{2}\bigl(4+(n-9)d\bigr)
=\frac{n}{2}(4+28)
=\frac{n}{2}\cdot 32=16n.
\]
So
\[
n=\frac{336}{16}=21.
\]

\[
\boxed{21}
\]
